starfall.description: Bright drifting stars and twin pastel orbits.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.description: Full-body flames with bright, flickering cores.

storm.name: Stormbound
storm.description: Branching blue lightning arcs around your body.

soulfire.name: Soulfire
soulfire.description: Tall spectral flames that spiral upward.

hellfire.name: Hellfire

tempest.name: Tempest

eclipse.name: Eclipse

pressure.name: Spiritual Pressure
pressure.description: Heavy violet pressure slows nearby enemies by up to 68% within 28m. Crushing violet columns, falling particles and a darkened sky distort the arena. You stay unaffected; inactive on the ledge.

ascension.name: Ascension
ascension.description: A towering golden aura with arena-wide wind pressure. Enemies take 2–3 damage each second. Inactive on the safe ledge.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: Waves of cyan, violet and pink.

royal.name: Sovereign
royal.description: A gilded frame with a sweeping shine.

prism.name: Prismatic
prism.description: A flowing rainbow across your name.
